skill.name: conductor-implement
skill.description: Guide Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through Conductor track implementation using TDD, progress tracking, verification checkpoints, and commits.
skill.summary: Implements Conductor track plans with TDD checkpoints and progress updates.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around file paths, statuses, and examples. Three findings are confirmed because the skill includes git and test command workflows that can change repository state or execute project scripts. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious network behavior was found.

remediation.issue: Repository-wide git staging is shown as part of task completion.
remediation.suggestion: Replace broad staging with explicit file lists and require user confirmation before every commit.

remediation.issue: Project test commands may execute repository-defined code.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users before running package scripts or test suites, and document that tests can execute local project code.

remediation.issue: Markdown command examples triggered shell-execution findings.
remediation.suggestion: Separate executable examples from documentation paths and label command blocks with clear safety notes.

static_findings.snippet: Execute tasks from a track's implementation plan, following the workflow rules defined in `conductor
- If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.
- If missing: Display error and suggest running `/conductor:setup` first
For each incomplete task in plan.md (marked with `[ ]`):
- Look for lines matching `- [ ] Task X.Y: {description}`
- Update plan.md: Change `[ ]` to `[~]` for current task
- If all tasks in current phase are `[x]`:
- Run full test suite: `npm test` / `pytest` / etc.
3. Check if task is `[~]` in plan.md
- Write minimum code to make test pass
- Run tests to confirm they pass

content.value_statement: Track plans can drift when implementation work lacks structure. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through TDD tasks, progress updates, commits, and checkpoints.
actual_capabilities: Selects or validates Conductor track plans from conductor tracking files.
Loads specification, plan, metadata, product, tech stack, workflow, and style guide documents.
Guides task execution through red, green, refactor, test, commit, and progress update steps.
Maintains track status, task status, metadata timestamps, phase progress, and completion summaries.
Stops on tool, test, or git failures and presents recovery options.
Requires user approval before moving between implementation phases.
limitations: Requires an existing Conductor project structure and track plan files.
Does not create the original track specification or implementation plan.
May run project tests and git commands when implementation proceeds.
Depends on the repository workflow and test commands already configured by the user.

use_cases.title: Implement a Planned Feature
use_cases.description: Work through an approved Conductor track, update task progress, and verify each implementation step.

use_cases.title: Enforce TDD Checkpoints
use_cases.description: Apply red, green, and refactor steps while keeping phase approvals and verification results visible.

use_cases.title: Resume Paused Work
use_cases.description: Load saved metadata, identify the current task, and continue from a known implementation state.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Track
prompt_templates.prompt: Use conductor-implement for the track named auth_20250115. Load the workflow, select the next task, and begin with the required TDD step.

prompt_templates.title: Implement One Task
prompt_templates.scenario: Run a single task from an existing track.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use conductor-implement with track auth_20250115 and task 2.3. Update progress, run the required verification, and stop for approval if the phase ends.

prompt_templates.title: Resume Work
prompt_templates.prompt: Use conductor-implement to resume the active track. Read metadata, identify the current task, and ask before continuing from the saved state.

prompt_templates.title: Complete a Phase
prompt_templates.scenario: Finish a phase with verification and approval.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use conductor-implement for track dashboard_20250113. Finish all remaining tasks in phase 2, verify acceptance criteria, summarize results, and wait for my approval.

output_examples.input: A developer asks to implement auth_20250115 from the next incomplete task.
output: Marks the selected task as in progress.
Guides the failing test, implementation, refactor, verification, and progress update steps.

output_examples.input: A phase completes after all planned tasks pass verification.
output_examples.output: Reports phase results, lists completed tasks, shows test and verification status, and asks the user to approve the next phase.

output_examples.input: A git or test command fails during implementation.
output_examples.output: Stops the workflow, explains the failure, and offers retry, fix, rollback, or pause choices.

best_practices: Use this skill on a branch with reviewed Conductor track files.
Confirm each command that changes repository state before it runs.
Review plan and metadata updates before marking a task or phase complete.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill when no Conductor track plan exists.
Do not skip verification checkpoints to finish a phase faster.
Do not stage unrelated files or secrets when committing task progress.

faq.question: Does this skill create new Conductor tracks?
faq.answer: No. It implements existing tracks that already have specification, plan, and metadata files.

faq.question: Does it require test driven development?
faq.answer: It follows the TDD strictness level defined in the project workflow file.

faq.question: Can it change repository files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide source changes, test changes, plan updates, metadata updates, and documentation sync offers.

faq.question: Does it commit changes automatically?
faq.answer: It includes commit workflow guidance. Users should confirm git commands before they run.

faq.question: Which AI tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it safe for production repositories?
faq.answer: Use a branch, review changes before commands run, and keep phase approval checkpoints enabled.
